title: RoBell-RVFL: A Robust Generalized Bell Random Vector Functional Link Network
abstract: arXiv:2608.16965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The dominance of majority classes in real-world datasets poses a fundamental challenge to randomized neural networks, often biasing decision boundaries and overlooking critical minority samples. Existing remedies, such as synthetic minority over-sampling (SMOTE) and class-weighted loss functions, primarily address class proportions while neglecting intra-class distribution, making them vulnerable to label noise and outliers. In this paper, we propose \textbf{RoBell-RVFL}, a robust and lightweight \emph{quality-aware} generalized bell random vector functional link network that redefines how randomized models handle class imbalance and noisy data. translated_title: RoBell-RVFL：一种稳健的广义贝尔随机向量函数链接网络
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16965v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现实世界数据集中多数类的支配地位对随机神经网络构成了根本性挑战，常常使决策边界产生偏差，并忽视关键的少数类样本。现有的补救措施，如合成少数类过采样（SMOTE）和类加权损失函数，主要解决类别比例问题，却忽略了类内分布，使其容易受到标签噪声和异常值的影响。在本文中，我们提出了\textbf{RoBell-RVFL}，一种稳健且轻量级的\emph{质量感知}广义贝尔随机向量函数链接网络，它重新定义了随机模型如何处理类别不平衡和噪声数据。RoBell-RVFL采用一种双策略、样本级加权机制，通过单位权重严格保留少数类信息，同时通过核中的概率加权广义贝尔（gbell）隶属函数自适应调节多数类样本的影响。
tldr: 本文提出了一种稳健的广义贝尔随机向量函数链接网络，通过样本级双策略加权机制，在保留少数类信息的同时自适应抑制多数类噪声影响，有效解决了类别不平衡和标签噪声问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a robust generalized Bell random vector functional link network with a dual-strategy sample-level weighting mechanism that preserves minority class information while adaptively mitigating majority class noise, effectively addressing class imbalance and label noise.
